newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed down by 1.61 percent on Tuesday in high trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 570.64 from 579.95 on Monday.
Trade volume was 15.79 million dinars against 4.29 million dinars. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 13.41 million dinars.
Banque du Sud was up 0.68 dinar to 26.1 dinars. BTEI bank was up 0.48 dinar to 22.280 dinars. STB bank was down 0.66 dinar to 21.37 dinars.
